title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: A ROC curve is a graphical plot that illustrates the diagnostic ability of a binary classifier system as its discrimination threshold is varied. It is created by plotting the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings.

title: Thresholds in ROC Curves
text: The thresholds are used to determine the point at which the predicted probabilities are classified as positive or negative. By varying these thresholds, you can plot different points on the ROC curve.
